items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: they were playing with a fellow named Prince Morris.

ctx.x: And they were playing at the same time as you and Pennsylvania.
Yeah, they were playing with a fellow named Prince Morris.

Joe Strada yeah had him on drum that's right I had him straight that's right that was Prince Morris' band you see now Joe Wynn he brought us up there and he stole Albert Morgan and Edmund Hall out of that band and put them with the band we had and then the band we had when we left here we left here with with Joy Morris on trombone the manager and Mack on trumpet the leader and Edmund Washington on clarinet and me on banjo Joe Wynn that's full fine right there what happened to Edmund Washington? well he was still…
